newsitem.title: USA: Amnex contemplates $50 mln note offering.
newsitem.headline: Amnex contemplates $50 mln note offering.

text.p: AMNEX Inc. said Thursday that it is considering an offer of $50 million in convertible subordinated debt securities to certain institutional and qualified investors, both domestically and abroad.
The exact terms of the proposed offering have not yet been fixed and will be determined in the light of market conditions at the time of the offering.
The company said that the contemplated offering will take place in the next 30 to 60 days.

The proceeds of this proposed offering, said the company, will be used to repurchase certain outstanding convertible promissory notes and convertible preferred shares, prepay certain other outstanding promissory notes, and to provide funds for potential acquisition, any short-term working capital needs and general corporate purposes.
